name: legwork
description: Decision research for Claude Code and Codex - cited findings where every claim states how well it is supported. Judges a source by whether it suits the claim it backs rather than by its domain, counts corroboration only across genuinely independent sources reached from different search angles, and says so plainly when the evidence cannot answer the question. Built-in WebSearch first (free); Bright Data CLI only as a fallback for blocked pages, Reddit and geo SERP. Three levels where depth raises rigour, never length.
